verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers an 'Embed' feature to publish a mini interactive API console on a webpage and team/workspace collaboration, which partially supports letting others discover/consume APIs, but there's no dedicated catalog/portal product for organizing and browsing multiple APIs, and a community report explicitly notes you 'can't create documentation for a folder/request.' missing for 10: dedicated API catalog/portal UI, folder/request-level documentation generation, discovery search across published APIs, independent evidence of teams using it as a portal.
